record.paper_title: Open Questions in CMR Manganites, Relevance of Clustered States, and Analogies with other Compounds
record.original_question: What do atomic-resolution scanning-tunneling-microscopy measurements reveal about phase separation and local electronic structure in manganites across many hole densities, especially in compositions that become ferromagnetic metals at low temperature?

evidence.quote: Atomic resolution STM experiments should be performed, at many hole densities. ... Extending experiments of this variety to other hole densities, particularly those where the system becomes ferromagnetic metallic at low temperatures, is of much importance.

artifact.category_tag: Strongly correlated electron systems / CMR manganites
artifact.status_search_result: Atomic-resolution STM/STS studies of manganites have been performed since the early 2000s and have directly imaged nanoscale electronic phase separation, including coexisting metallic and insulating domains of 1–2 nm in hole-doped compositions, and have probed local gaps and their evolution with field and temperature. However, systematic coverage across the full hole-density range, and especially detailed atomic-resolution mapping in compositions that are ferromagnetic metals at low temperature, remains incomplete; the broad program is therefore partially addressed rather than fully resolved.

status_evidence.title: Direct experimental evidence of physical origin of electronic phase separation in manganites
status_evidence.snippet: Electronic phase separation has been observed in real space with atomic-scale resolution in perovskite manganites, crucial for the CMR effect.
status_evidence.claim: Atomic-scale real-space imaging of phase separation in manganites has been achieved.

status_evidence.title: The nanoscale phase separation in hole-doped manganites
status_evidence.snippet: Reviews nanoscale phase separation observed in hole-doped manganites including coexistence of FM metallic and insulating domains.
status_evidence.claim: Nanoscale FM-metallic/insulating coexistence has been documented in hole-doped manganites.

status_evidence.title: Research progress on electronic phase separation in low-dimensional perovskite manganite nanostructures
status_evidence.snippet: Microscopically homogeneous clusters of 1–2 nm dispersed in an insulating matrix have been observed.
status_evidence.claim: STM-type probes reveal ~1–2 nm metallic clusters in an insulating matrix, but full doping-range mapping is still incomplete.
